title: Credo (Anonymous, Missa L'ardant desir)
desc: Anonymous, Missa L'ardant desir, Credo. 4 voices (Discantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Capella Sistina 51. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ano1025c); encoded by Jesse Rodin & Emily Zazulia. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
